behavior.dispatch: Per-user Windows handler validates symbol and period, then reuses windows_tradingview.ps1 to pass one HTTPS chart argument to installed TradingView.exe

real_windows_parser.notes: Compiles and executes the C# parser; no UI launch. Uses unittest because the remote venv has no pytest.

validation.public_javascript: HTTPS response contains Windows native protocol branch and removes target=_blank on Windows links
validation.blocker: UU remote viewer showed the live Windows desktop, but CUA mouse and keyboard events did not reach Windows; no native launch or chart-render success is claimed for this run
validation.dispatch_receipt: No click receipt existed at the last readback
validation.cleanup: Ended the task's UU remote connection through its Exit remote control menu; preserved Windows user browser tabs, TradingView, and existing client task
